name: Poona Dal and Oil Industries Limited
about: Poona Dal and Oil Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and trading of edible oils and pulses in India. The company operates in two segments, Oil Division and Agro Division. It offers its products under its HIRA, TIGER, SURAJ, MOTI, and 111 (Triple One) brand names. The company was formerly known as Suryaoday Agro Industries Ltd. and changed its name to Poona Dal and Oil Industries Limited in 1997. Poona Dal and Oil Industries Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Pune, India.
